compatibility_matrix.dstar_or_application: application emits explicit routes and closed static action expressions
compatibility_matrix.jido_code_disposition: prove exact Origin Fetch-Metadata content-type and method admission in the consumer spike

compatibility_matrix.dstar_or_application: Dstar.Signals.read reads GET/DELETE datastar query JSON and other methods from the body
compatibility_matrix.datastar_1_0_3: GET/DELETE serialize filtered JSON into datastar query; POST/PUT/PATCH send JSON body
compatibility_matrix.jido_code_disposition: GET is read-only; mutations use POST/PUT/PATCH; DELETE is avoided; every signal schema and byte limit is application-owned

compatibility_matrix.dstar_or_application: ordinary Phoenix forms and controllers remain authoritative
compatibility_matrix.datastar_1_0_3: form content uses URL encoding or multipart body on body-capable methods
compatibility_matrix.jido_code_disposition: native action/method/CSRF path first, then exact enhanced parity

compatibility_matrix.dstar_or_application: Dstar RenameCsrfParam can copy a nonlocal csrf signal from body or query
compatibility_matrix.datastar_1_0_3: nonlocal signals are sent and GET/DELETE place them in the URL
compatibility_matrix.jido_code_disposition: default Dstar csrf-signal pattern is prohibited; use native form token or qualified same-origin header/body transport with no credential in URL

compatibility_matrix.dstar_or_application: Dstar.Elements emits datastar-patch-elements with selector mode namespace useViewTransition and elements lines
compatibility_matrix.datastar_1_0_3: recognizes datastar-patch-elements and outer inner remove replace prepend append before after modes
compatibility_matrix.jido_code_disposition: only stable authorized roots and bounded escaped HTML; Phase 3 proves morph focus and overlay behavior

compatibility_matrix.dstar_or_application: Dstar.Signals emits datastar-patch-signals with signals and optional onlyIfMissing
compatibility_matrix.datastar_1_0_3: merges JSON signal patches and deletes null paths unless onlyIfMissing applies
compatibility_matrix.jido_code_disposition: signals are untrusted bounded presentation intent and never authority or durable state

compatibility_matrix.dstar_or_application: Dstar.SSE emits safe CR/LF-split data lines and strips line breaks from event id and retry fields
compatibility_matrix.datastar_1_0_3: parses text/event-stream, remembers last-event-id and applies Datastar-prefixed events
compatibility_matrix.jido_code_disposition: application owns response admission event and patch ceilings heartbeat lifetime reauthorization and terminal closure

compatibility_matrix.dstar_or_application: application may return bounded HTML or JSON
compatibility_matrix.datastar_1_0_3: 200 text/html dispatches an element patch and 200 application/json dispatches a signal patch
compatibility_matrix.jido_code_disposition: only documented bounded response shapes; text/javascript is prohibited

compatibility_matrix.dstar_or_application: Dstar documents retryMaxCount as consecutive failure count only
compatibility_matrix.datastar_1_0_3: successful HTTP 200 resets the counter; auto/error/always/never modes and exponential backoff are client behavior
compatibility_matrix.jido_code_disposition: application hard lifetime revocation reconnect suppression and connection limits are mandatory because retryMaxCount cannot bound successful reconnect cycles

compatibility_matrix.dstar_or_application: Dstar raises on invalid modes namespaces verbs and unsafe helper input
compatibility_matrix.datastar_1_0_3: dispatches started finished error retrying and retries-failed fetch events and rejects blocked CSP compilation
compatibility_matrix.jido_code_disposition: server returns a closed sanitized outcome and native recovery; no source path secret or exception disclosure

compatibility_matrix.dstar_or_application: Dstar expressions are generated strings and Dstar.Scripts can emit executable script elements
compatibility_matrix.datastar_1_0_3: data-nonce opt-in compiles expressions with nonce-bearing transient scripts instead of Function
compatibility_matrix.jido_code_disposition: nonce mode is mandatory; generated expressions must be static reviewed source; Dstar.Scripts remains prohibited

risk_register.risk: Datastar v1.0.3 has no uploaded release asset and its release tree lacks the package manifest and lock needed to reproduce bundles
risk_register.mitigation: vendor the exact signed-tag bundle bytes and verify source archive bundle and application output digests in clean checkouts
risk_register.reopening_condition: a rebuilt or downloaded bundle receives the selected digest without byte-for-byte verification

risk_register.risk: nonce CSP mode dynamically creates transient scripts and a Trusted Types policy
risk_register.mitigation: prove enforcing CSP without unsafe-eval unsafe-inline or remote sources and qualify the datastar Trusted Types policy
risk_register.reopening_condition: CSP is weakened or nonce and Trusted Types behavior is inferred instead of tested

risk_register.risk: default nonlocal csrf signals can enter GET/DELETE URLs and all nonlocal signals are transmitted by default
risk_register.mitigation: reject DELETE enhanced actions and default RenameCsrfParam transport; use closed filtered schemas plus qualified header/body CSRF
risk_register.reopening_condition: a credential enters signals URLs logs or referrers or an open signal schema is accepted

risk_register.risk: client retryMaxCount does not bound reconnect cycles that obtain successful HTTP 200 responses
risk_register.mitigation: application-owned admission hard lifetime reauthorization connection ceilings terminal revocation and reconnect suppression
risk_register.reopening_condition: Datastar retry count or Dstar StreamRegistry is treated as lifetime quota revocation or authority

risk_register.risk: the Datastar release commit has no attached check runs or accepted browser support matrix
risk_register.mitigation: run pinned real-browser native enhanced CSP morph focus disconnect and recovery suites in HUI-B3 and HUI-B4
risk_register.reopening_condition: ES2021 source target or upstream release status is presented as supported-browser evidence

risk_register.risk: Dstar tag is unsigned and Datastar signer key is not present in the local trust store
risk_register.mitigation: combine exact commits trees archives Hex checksum and GitHub-verified Datastar signature; require fresh review on signer or tag drift
risk_register.reopening_condition: tag labels alone are treated as integrity or the GitHub signature result changes

risk_register.risk: Dstar 0.2.0 documents Datastar v1.0 while the selected client is patch 1.0.3 and adds optional response behavior not emitted by Dstar
risk_register.mitigation: pin the exact behavior matrix and prove every selected request event morph retry error and CSP behavior in the consumer fixture
risk_register.reopening_condition: semver compatibility replaces exact protocol tests or an unrecorded data line is emitted

update_policy.pinning: Dstar exact Hex version checksum source commit tree archive and license plus Datastar exact signed tag commit tree archive bundle and source-map digests
update_policy.patch_policy: no local patch or fork selected; any byte change creates a new candidate identity and repeats HUI-B1 review
